basics.name: Gio Jung
basics.label: Machine Learning Engineer, Multimodal ML Systems & LLM Evaluation
basics.summary: M.S. Computer Science (SFSU). I build and rigorously evaluate multimodal ML and LLM systems, from distributed training on HPC clusters to systematic model evaluation.

courses: Thesis: "Evaluation of Vision Language Models using Item Response Theory"

work.name: YouDescribe Lab
work.summary: Accessibility research lab advancing video audio description (AD) for blind and low-vision users; leading systematic model evaluation to validate VLMs as raters and describers.
highlights: Leading key frame selection research to improve VLM-based evaluation and description of video AD.

Validated 100+ VLMs as raters across image captioning and video AD by building end-to-end evaluation pipelines with Hugging Face and LangChain-based API integrations, supporting 2 ongoing research submissions.
Uncovered model-specific strengths and failure patterns across 7 quality rating dimensions by applying Item Response Theory (IRT) to compare VLM and human rater performance.

work.name: Pittsburgh Supercomputing Center
work.summary: Project funded by the NAIRR Pilot, scaling a video captioning model (TimeSformer × GPT-2).
highlights: Prepared and transferred 60K+ VATEX video clips to PSC HPC clusters, preprocessing frames for efficient distributed data loading at scale.
Co-trained a 400M+ parameter video captioning model across 16 NVIDIA H100 GPUs (2 nodes) using DeepSpeed Pipeline Parallelism, achieving CIDEr 63 on the VATEX benchmark.

work.name: Astro Information Security
work.summary: Information security startup; built internal email automation tooling.
highlights: Designed an email classification MCP pipeline to process 1K+ messages with automated rule-based filtering.

projects.name: eBay 2025 University ML Competition
projects.summary: Top 4 finish: sequence labeling for a German marketplace.
highlights: Ranked Top 4 by iteratively fine-tuning sequence labeling models for a German marketplace, reaching F1 = 0.94 through systematic preprocessing and model selection.

projects.name: ChillMate
projects.summary: AI mental health chatbot for accessible emotional support.
highlights: Built an AI mental health chatbot using React, MongoDB, and a RAG-powered conversation engine, while leading a team of 7 as Scrum Master through full project delivery.
